newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Bielsko-Biala plans PLN 100 mln muni issue.
newsitem.headline: Polish Bielsko-Biala plans PLN 100 mln muni issue.

text.p: Poland's southwestern city of Biesko-Biala wants to privately place 100 million zlotys of municipal bonds in July 1997, a city official said on Friday.
"The city council set the value of the issue at 100 million zlotys," an official from Biesko-Biala's economic policy department, who asked not to be named, told Reuters.
He said the city was looking for a financial and legal advisor for the issue, likely to be either four- or five-year municial bonds privately placed with at most 299 investors.
Bielsko-Biala, which has a sub-compact automobile factory owned by Italy's Fiat Spa, wants to pick the issue's advisor on January 15.
The city wants to use the cash to improve infrastructure and construction works.
